aliases.Patient workspace में Care Timeline खोले: In the Patient workspace, choose Care Timeline. It shows recorded milestones and pending items. Sign in to view your own records.
aliases.मैं रिपोर्ट या प्रिस्क्रिप्शन कैसे अपलोड: How do I upload a report or prescription?
aliases.Patient workspace में Records खोलें, फ़ा: Open Records in the Patient workspace, choose a document and upload it. Select its type and sharing preference. Uploading a report does not mean a clinician has reviewed it.
aliases.मैं हिंदी या अपनी क्षेत्रीय भाषा कैसे चु: How do I change the language?
aliases.भाषा के विकल्प में English, हिंदी या मरा: Choose English, Hindi or Marathi from the language selector. Your choice is shared across the app and Dhruv. Device read-aloud depends on the voices installed on your device.
aliases.मैं पति या परिवार को रिकॉर्ड का एक्सेस क: How can my husband or family access my records?
aliases.अपनी सहमति से ही साझा करें। Records में: Share only with your consent. Records provides document sharing controls; a separate family-account access flow is not available here yet. Ask your care team for the approved process. Do not share your password or OTP.
aliases.मैं आवाज़ से कैसे बात करूँ?: How can I talk using my voice?
aliases.माइक दबाएँ, ब्राउज़र को माइक्रोफ़ोन की अ: Press the microphone, allow browser microphone access and speak. Choose English or Hindi first. The Voice button reads replies aloud. If your browser does not support speech recognition, type your question. Browser speech services may process your audio.
aliases.पहला एंटीनेटल चेकअप कब कराना चाहिए?: When should I have my first antenatal checkup?
aliases.गर्भावस्था का पता चलते ही पहला चेकअप करा: Arrange your first antenatal visit as soon as pregnancy is known, ideally within the first 12 weeks. Your care team sets your personal schedule.
aliases.गर्भावस्था में कितने चेकअप ज़रूरी हैं?: How many pregnancy checkups are needed?
aliases.WHO सामान्य गर्भावस्था में कम से कम 8 AN: WHO recommends at least 8 antenatal contacts for an uncomplicated pregnancy, starting within 12 weeks. Your local care plan may differ; twins or clinician-identified concerns can need extra visits. Follow the schedule your clinician records.
aliases.शिशु के विकास को देखने वाला anomaly scan: The mid-pregnancy anomaly scan is commonly offered around 18–21 weeks to look at the baby’s development. Follow the date given by your clinician; it is a screening scan, not a guarantee about every condition.
aliases.OGTT यानी oral glucose tolerance test। भ: OGTT means oral glucose tolerance test. Indian care programmes screen for diabetes during pregnancy, including at first contact and, when indicated, again at 24–28 weeks. Ask your team which date and preparation apply to you.
aliases.आयरन और कैल्शियम की गोली कब शुरू होती है: When do iron and calcium supplements usually start?
aliases.नियमित iron–folic acid आम तौर पर दूसरी त: Routine iron–folic acid supplementation is generally part of care from the second trimester; Indian calcium guidance starts at 14 weeks. Your clinician decides your start date and prescription. Do not start, stop or change a dose based on this chat.
aliases.भारत के शेड्यूल में Td-1 गर्भावस्था में: Under India’s schedule, Td-1 is given early in pregnancy and Td-2 four weeks later. A booster may apply depending on previous doses. Your vaccination record and clinician determine what you need.
aliases.डिलीवरी के बैग में क्या रखें?: What should I pack for delivery?
aliases.care records, रिपोर्ट, hospital registra: Bring your care records and reports, hospital registration details, comfortable clothes, maternity pads, baby clothes, nappies, toiletries and a phone charger. Ask your hospital for its checklist and any scheme documents.
aliases.Hb, GDM, EDD, CTG और NT scan का मतलब क्य: What do Hb, GDM, EDD, CTG and NT scan mean?
aliases.Hb: ऑक्सीजन ले जाने वाला haemoglobin। GD: Hb: haemoglobin, the blood protein that carries oxygen. GDM: diabetes first diagnosed during pregnancy. EDD: estimated delivery date. CTG: a recording of fetal heart rate and contractions. NT scan: an early ultrasound measurement used in screening. A clinician interprets your results.
aliases.इसका अर्थ है कि डॉक्टर ने अधिक निगरानी य: It means a clinician has identified a reason for closer monitoring or specialist care. It does not mean a complication is certain. Only a clinician can assign or change this status; Dhruv cannot assess your personal risk.
aliases.जुड़वाँ में DCDA और MCDA का मतलब क्या है: What do DCDA and MCDA mean in twins?
aliases.DCDA: दोनों बच्चों की अलग chorion और पान: DCDA: each baby has a separate chorion and amniotic sac; the placentas may appear joined. MCDA: the babies share a chorion/placenta but have separate amniotic sacs. The scan team confirms the type and follow-up plan.
aliases.डिलीवरी के बाद पहला चेकअप कब होता है?: When is the first checkup after delivery?
aliases.जन्म के पहले 24 घंटे में care शुरू होती: Care starts in the first 24 hours after birth. WHO recommends further contacts at 48–72 hours, 7–14 days and week 6; Indian programmes may include additional home visits. Use your discharge plan for your exact dates.
aliases.स्तनपान कब शुरू करें? दूध कम लगे तो किसस: When should breastfeeding start, and who can help with low milk?
aliases.माँ और बच्चा सक्षम हों तो जन्म के पहले घ: When mother and baby are able, support breastfeeding within the first hour after birth. For feeding difficulty or concern about milk supply, ask a nurse, lactation counsellor or paediatrician for a feeding assessment.
aliases.डिलीवरी के बाद मन उदास रहता है, किससे बा: My mood is low after delivery. Who can I talk to?
aliases.अपने obstetrician, nurse या mental-healt: Tell your obstetrician, nurse or a mental-health professional, and a trusted person who can support you. Ask for a postnatal mood assessment. You do not have to manage this alone. If you feel in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
aliases.गर्भनिरोध के विकल्प कहाँ जानूँ?: Where can I learn about contraception?
aliases.postnatal या family-planning clinic में: Ask your postnatal or family-planning clinic for counselling on options that fit your health, breastfeeding and preferences. Dhruv can explain where to get counselling, but cannot select or prescribe a method.
aliases.मेरे बच्चे के टीकों का शेड्यूल क्या है?: What is my baby’s vaccination schedule?
aliases.भारत के UIP में जन्म के टीके, 6, 10, 14: India’s UIP includes birth doses, visits at 6, 10 and 14 weeks, and later doses at 9–12 and 16–24 months, with further boosters. Open the Child workspace → Vaccines and choose the correct baby for recorded due dates. Your vaccinator confirms the current schedule.
aliases.कोई टीका छूट गया तो क्या करूँ?: What if a vaccine was missed?
aliases.बच्चे का vaccination card लेकर immunisat: Take the baby’s vaccination card to the immunisation clinic or ANM and ask for a catch-up plan. They will confirm the next eligible dose and date; Dhruv does not choose a catch-up dose.
aliases.बच्चे का वज़न और विकास कब जाँचा जाता है?: When is my baby’s growth and weight checked?
aliases.child-health और immunisation visits में: Growth is reviewed during scheduled child-health and immunisation visits. The care team sets intervals for weight, length and head circumference. Open the Child workspace for recorded measurements; ask a paediatrician about the growth pattern.
aliases.जुड़वाँ बच्चों के रिकॉर्ड अलग कैसे दिखते: How are twins’ records kept separate?
aliases.हर बच्चे की अलग child ID और birth order: Each baby has a separate child ID and birth order. In the Child workspace, select the baby before viewing vaccines, growth or records. Check the name/ID and birth order before every entry.
aliases.मेरा कोई टेस्ट या विज़िट लंबित है?: Do I have any pending tests or visits?
aliases.साइन इन करके Care Timeline में pending य: Open your signed-in Care Timeline for pending or overdue items. I cannot see your private timeline in this chat, so I cannot confirm whether you personally have a pending test or visit.
aliases.Appointments में अपनी अगली दर्ज booking: Open Appointments to see your recorded next booking. I do not have access to your personal appointment dates here. If no booking is listed, contact your care team.
aliases.अपॉइंटमेंट बुक या रीशेड्यूल कैसे करूँ?: How do I book or reschedule an appointment?
aliases.अपने workspace में Appointments खोलकर bo: Open Appointments in your workspace to view available booking or change options. Follow the confirmation shown there; this chat does not book or reschedule for you. Contact the clinic if a change option is unavailable.
aliases.मेरे पास कौन-सा अस्पताल या PHC है?: Which hospital or PHC is near me?
aliases.care workspace के hospital/location विकल: Use the hospital/location options in your care workspace or ask your ANM for a nearby PHC. This chat does not have your location and cannot verify live facility availability. Demo facilities are fictional.
aliases.रिपोर्ट के बाद अगला कदम क्या है?: What happens after my report is uploaded?
aliases.Records में status देखें और assigned cli: Open Records to check its status and ask your assigned clinician to review it. A result needs clinical interpretation; an upload alone does not confirm treatment, a diagnosis or completion of every care task.
aliases.इमरजेंसी में SOS कैसे दबाऊँ?: How do I use SOS in an emergency?
aliases.Patient dashboard का SOS बटन खोलें और नि: Open the SOS control on your Patient dashboard and follow the prompts. If it is unavailable, go to the nearest hospital. Demo SOS does not dispatch real emergency services.
aliases.SOS के बाद क्या होता है और verification: What happens after SOS, and why is verification needed?
aliases.SOS में पुष्टि के बाद receiving team अनु: SOS requests confirmation before the receiving team reviews the request. Verification helps reject accidental or false requests. Do not wait for the app in an emergency; go to the nearest hospital. Demo routing is simulated.
aliases.Turant SOS dabaiye ya nazdiki hospital j: Press SOS immediately or go to the nearest hospital.
aliases.PM-JAY किसे मिल सकता है?: Who may be eligible for PM-JAY?
aliases.PM-JAY: पात्रता सरकारी beneficiary lists: PM-JAY: eligibility depends on government beneficiary lists and applicable state coverage. Check your household through the official NHA/PM-JAY portal. Final confirmation must come from the official site.
aliases.JSY किसे मिल सकता है?: Who may be eligible for JSY?
aliases.JSY: पात्र institutional delivery के लिए: JSY: assistance for eligible institutional deliveries. Eligibility differs by state category, facility and beneficiary category; low-performing states have broader coverage. Final confirmation must come from the official NHM site.
aliases.PMMVY किसे मिल सकता है?: Who may be eligible for PMMVY?
aliases.PMMVY: निर्धारित सामाजिक/आर्थिक श्रेणी क: PMMVY: eligible women in specified social/economic categories may receive maternity benefits for the first child and, under PMMVY 2.0, a second child if a girl, subject to conditions and exclusions. Final confirmation must come from the official WCD site.
aliases.योजनाओं के दस्तावेज़ और official links क: Which scheme documents and official links do I need?
aliases.PM-JAY: सरकारी beneficiary पात्रता। JSY:: PM-JAY: government beneficiary eligibility. JSY: eligible institutional delivery, with state-specific rules. PMMVY: eligible maternity-benefit categories. Document requirements vary; check the official portals below. Final confirmation must come from the official site.
aliases.मेरा डेटा कौन देख सकता है? डॉक्टर को क्य: Who can see my data? What can the doctor see?
aliases.एक्सेस आपकी consent और staff की role/ass: Access depends on your consent and the staff member’s role and assignment. Review Settings → Privacy and document sharing in Records. This assistant does not retrieve private records or send your question to an AI model.
aliases.मैं डेटा delete या share कैसे करूँ?: How do I delete or share my data?
